16. 圖中，扇形 OAB 及扇形 OCD 的圓心均為 O。若 « AB = 12π cm 、 « CD = 16π cm 及 OA = 30 cm ， 則 AC = 
A. 5 cm 。
B. 10 cm 。
C. 20 cm 。
D. 40 cm 。
reasoning: Let $\theta$ be the central angle of both sectors. For sector $OAB$, the arc length is $\overparen{AB} = OA \cdot \theta$, so $12\pi = 30 \cdot \theta$, which gives $\theta = \frac{12\pi}{30} = \frac{2\pi}{5}$. For sector $OCD$, the arc length is $\overparen{CD} = OC \cdot \theta$, so $16\pi = OC \cdot \frac{2\pi}{5}$. Solving for $OC$ gives $OC = \frac{16\pi \cdot 5}{2\pi} = 40$ cm. The length $AC = OC - OA = 40 \text{ cm} - 30 \text{ cm} = 10 \text{ cm}$.
